**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is tasked with creating a Bluetooth (BT) device management bulletin board for their company.
- [PREFERENCE] The user prefers a bulletin board format rather than a Google spreadsheet for the device management system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested using Google Sheets for a simple device management system, including steps to create a new Google Sheet, set up a table with headers, share the sheet, provide update instructions, and populate the table with device information.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a step-by-step guide to creating a BT device management system using Google Sheets, detailing how to create headers such as "Device Name", "Device Type", "Status", "Current Owner", and "Last Updated".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained how to share the Google Sheet with users and set permissions for editing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant included instructions for users on how to update the device status in the Google Sheet.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a basic outline for developing a web-based bulletin board system using Flask, including code snippets for a Flask application and an HTML template.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned the need to install Python and Flask and provided the command to install Flask using pip.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created a sample Flask application code that includes routes for displaying the device management bulletin board and updating device information.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided an HTML template for the bulletin board, including a table structure to display device information and a form for updating device status.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant instructed the user to run the Flask application and access the bulletin board via a web browser at the address http://127.0.0.1:5000/.
